verified_facts.text: The resort is set on the cliff tops above the Pacific Ocean in Acapulco's Diamond Zone.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on the cliff tops above the glistening Pacific Ocean, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués is a hidden gem in Acapulco’s Diamond Zone

verified_facts.text: Located in Punta Diamante, the resort is set within a gated cliffside enclave.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in Punta Diamante, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués is set within a gated cliffside enclave

verified_facts.text: The villas blend Thai-inspired design with Mexican craftsmanship.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step inside to discover a singular blend of Thai-inspired design and Mexican craftsmanship, each detail thoughtfully curated.

verified_facts.text: All villas include a private pool, with heating available upon request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, all our villas include a private pool, maintained at a comfortable temperature, with heating available upon request.

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose from villa locations and views including Hillside, Bay View, Ocean View and Oceanfront, subject to availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can choose from various room locations and views, including Hillside, Bay View, Ocean View, and Oceanfront, subject to availability.

verified_facts.text: The Oceanfront Pool Villa has a king-size bed oriented toward the horizon, expansive verandas and a private heated infinity pool that seems suspended above the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: it features a king-size bed oriented toward the horizon, expansive verandas, and a private heated infinity pool seemingly suspended above the water.

verified_facts.text: The Wellbeing Sanctuary Pool Villa has spaces for yoga, meditation and private practice, with wellbeing equipment such as yoga mats.
verified_facts.excerpt: features multifunctional spaces for yoga, meditation, and private practice, complete with curated wellbeing equipment such as yoga mats and fitness essentials.

verified_facts.text: The Ocean View Two-Bedroom Family Pool Villa has two separate pavilions, one with a king-size bed and one with twin beds, a shared sundeck and a heated private pool overlooking the Pacific.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring two separate pavilions with a king-size bed in one bedroom and twin beds in the other, a shared sundeck, and a heated private pool overlooking the Pacific Ocean.

verified_facts.text: The spa combines Asian healing traditions with Mexico's apapacho.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our spa, where Asian healing traditions meet the warmth of Mexico’s apapacho, an embrace for body and soul.

verified_facts.text: Signature spa treatments are Thai and Balinese massages enhanced with Mexican ingredients like honey, cacao and lavender.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Thai and Balinese massages enhanced with Mexican ingredients like honey, cacao, and lavender.

verified_facts.text: Spa guests are led to a private therapy pavilion, where they sip herbal tea during a foot bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: A dedicated Spa Concierge leads you to a tranquil private therapy pavilion where you can sip herbal tea while being treated to a soothing foot bath.

verified_facts.text: Besides the private villa pools, the resort has the Reflections Infinity Pool near Cello restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: In addition to a private pool in every villa, the Reflections Infinity Pool, located near Cello restaurant, provides a serene atmosphere and spectacular views.

verified_facts.text: The Las Rocas Infinity Pool sits in an intimate corner along the coastline, with seafood and prime cuts from the grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take a dip in our infinity pool, set in an intimate corner of Cabo Marqués along the coastline, where you can enjoy fresh seafood and prime cuts prepared on the grill

verified_facts.text: Saffron is the resort's Thai restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of our culinary offering is Saffron, our acclaimed Thai restaurant

verified_facts.text: Cello serves Northern Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cello presents the essence of Northern Italian cuisine

verified_facts.text: An in-villa barbecue service turns the villa's timber terrace into a private open-air restaurant with a personal chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: our bespoke Acapulco in-villa barbecue service transforms your personal timber terrace into an exclusive, open-air restaurant

verified_facts.text: A floating breakfast can be delivered to the villa's private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Begin your morning with a touch of luxury as a floating breakfast is delivered to your villa’s private pool.

verified_facts.text: Resort activities include tequila and mezcal tastings and cooking classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Try Mexico’s finest tequila and mezcal as you learn about its history, or discover your culinary talents in our cooking classes.

verified_facts.text: Kids can have a tepee set up in their own villa, with cookies and milk.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spoil your kids with a tepee within your own villa - cookies and milk included.

verified_facts.text: The resort is primarily designed for couples and tranquil getaways but also welcomes families.
verified_facts.excerpt: while Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués is primarily designed for couples and tranquil getaways, we also welcome families.

verified_facts.text: The resort does not offer dedicated children's facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that the resort does not offer dedicated children’s facilities.

verified_facts.text: Because of its clifftop location, the resort has no on-site beach; beach clubs are about 20 minutes away.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, due to our clifftop location, the resort does not have an on-site beach. However, we can recommend beach clubs located about 20 minutes away

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 15 km, roughly a 25-minute drive, from Acapulco city centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are conveniently located 15 km (approx. 25-minute drive) away from Acapulco city centre.

verified_facts.text: The resort welcomes dogs and cats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués welcomes dogs and cats.
